mission.title: Groundwork
mission.description: Plant a bug in an important Merovingian operations center.

npc.say: Hey! Whoa! Easy with that. Man. You're not gonna get out the door without breaking it at this rate.
I know you won't let me down, operative. Zion and I rely on your abilities.
Words convey meaning, operative, but it is actions by which we are judged. The time for action is approaching--the time that will define us.

phase.briefing:
Warrior, Commander Lock tells me that the Zion Council has decided not to pursue direct hostilities against the Kid and his "E Pluribus Neo" group. Although their vow to offer freedom from the Matrix to all bluepills, not just those who first reject the Matrix on their own, strains the terms of the Truce, and could lead to serious friction with the Machines, the Kid's constant invocation of Zion's hero, Neo, makes an attack upon his group political suicide; the council fears mass protests in Zion. An increase of rumors concerning Morpheus has added to the difficulty.
Of course, we hardly lack for other arenas in which to use your talents. Our efforts against the Merovingian have been proceeding better than expected. Intel has just received a tip on an important Merovingian operations center. We need you to plant a bug in this center. Information intercepted by the bug will give us advance notice of the Exile's plans. Pick up the bug from our operative, Aoluta.

enter.say: Aoluta should be in there with the bug.

talk.say: Careful with this thing. Oh, it won't crawl up in your belly button like a Machine bug, but it's fragile, so handle it carefully. All right, go on and take it from me, gently.

done.say: Careful! We need this thing to be fully functional!

phase.briefing: Planting a bug in an active enemy operations center without being spotted can be difficult. Fortunately, we've got the perfect decoys: the General's commandos. A squad of them is waiting for you. Rendezvous with them and conduct them out of the building.

enter.say: I've got the commando squad in there; code scan's clean otherwise.

talk.say: You can count on us, sir!
Training with Zion has been very beneficial to our strategy and combat routines, sir!
Ready to take down some Mervs, sir!

objective.text: Lead the commandos out of the building

phase.briefing:
Good work, {player}. Now, take the commandos with you to the target zone. You're looking for a specific computer on which you'll be planting the bug. Leave the commandos in a room nearby to create a distraction while you place the bug on the target. Your operator will instruct you further once you're inside the building.
Oh, I should warn you that we've received reports of EMP-like devices being used by Merovingian operatives. Apparently they are capable of destroying any of the General's commandos in the immediate vicinity. Fortunately, these devices appear to be in short supply.

enter.say: That place is heavily wired to call in backup--too many circuits for me to disconnect from out here. You'll have heat coming down once you've placed the bug. I'll let you know where to station the commandos once you reach the right spot.
Clear the out the guards in the next two rooms.

done.say: The computer you need to bug is in that room.
Nice. Now leave the commandos in the outer room, and plant the bug on the computer in the inner room. The commandos will prevent any backup guards from spotting you while you're bugging the computer.

objective.text: Plant the bug on the computer

done.say: Here comes their backup, right on schedule. Get out of that room before they spot you around the computer. We can't have them finding the bug.

phase.briefing:
That was very well done, Warrior. Our sensors show that the bug is transmitting data at peak efficiency. Hah--there I go, sounding like Agent Gray.
Since you wrapped this operation up so punctually, you're just in time for a quick briefing with our commanding officers. Something big is in the works. You'll get more from them; just follow your waypoint.

enter.say: Code stream shows redpills in there. Looks like our people.
Niobe and Ghost? This must be big.

talk.say: Niobe has an important message for you.

Hey, operative. I asked for you because I've heard of the success you've had in your operations against the Merovingian. I wanted to let you know in person--and this is not to go outside this room, understand?--that we're gearing up for an all-out offensive against his remaining forces soon. I can't say when, exactly; we still have details to work out. We'll have some important work for you.
Be ready for it, {player}. I'm counting on you.

mission.finish: That bug you placed was part of the plan helping to lay the groundwork for the offensive to come. Perhaps the hardest part of battle is holding ourselves in readiness: maintaining an alert, balanced state, without exhausting ourselves or losing our sense of purpose. Be ready for what comes, Warrior, whether it is tomorrow, or a year from now. Be ready, for Zion will call on you.
